Admissions for International Students
UT welcomes applications for admission from all countries and encourages students to examine and compare the many educational opportunities available.
Application Deadlines
Knowing the deadlines for applying to a program at UT is critical for the success of your application. If a program has deadlines that are earlier than those listed below, those deadlines take priority. Check with your Director of Graduate Studies for any program deadlines.
All international applicants intending to enroll with visa types F and J must follow the deadlines below. International applicants intending to enroll with other visa types may be eligible to apply after the deadlines noted below and should contact the Office of Graduate Admissions for more information.
Term
Online Submission
File Completion
Fall
April 15
May 15
Spring
June 15
October 1
Summer
October 15
February 15
The online submission deadline is when the initial application must be submitted online, provided the department has no earlier deadline. By the file completion deadline, admission must be granted and all documents required to obtain a student visa must be submitted to the Division of Global Engagement.
Admission Requirements
For admission to a graduate program, an international student must have an equivalent 4-year bachelor’s degree. Individuals with degrees from non-U.S. institutions must have earned a minimum of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale on all undergraduate work and a minimum of 3.3 on a 4.0 scale on all graduate work. U.S. degree holders must have earned a minimum 2.7 out of a possible 4.0 GPA or a minimum of 3.0 during the senior year of undergraduate study and a minimum of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale on all graduate work.
Costs
Please visit the Center for Global Engagement website for the most current estimate of expenses.
